facts.raw_span: A 47-year-old Caucasian woman
23-year history of presumed multiple sclerosis
four episodes of optic neuritis since 1989
longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis in 1995
persistently negative cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) oligoclonal bands
unremarkable brain MRI scans
subacute onset of expressive aphasia and right-sided hemiparesis
expressive language impairment and 3/5 strength in the right arm and leg
normal complete blood count and metabolic panel
large T2-hyperintense, tumefactive lesion in the left prefrontal white matter
serum aquaporin-4 antibody titre was 1:1000 by cell-based assay
no evidence of intrathecal immunoglobulin synthesis, no oligoclonal bands, and a normal cell count

persistently negative cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) oligoclonal bands
unremarkable brain MRI scans
subacute onset of expressive aphasia and right-sided hemiparesis
expressive language impairment and 3/5 strength in the right arm and leg
normal complete blood count and metabolic panel

concepts.why: The patient's history of optic neuritis and transverse myelitis, along with the presence of aquaporin-4 antibodies, supports this diagnosis
The patient's history of multiple sclerosis and the presence of a tumefactive lesion on MRI support this diagnosis
The presence of a tumefactive lesion on MRI and the lack of evidence for other diseases support this diagnosis
The presence of a tumefactive lesion on MRI supports this diagnosis, although it is less likely than other options
It explains the uncovered finding of persistently negative cerebrospinal fluid oligoclonal bands and no evidence of intrathecal immunoglobulin synthesis.

rationales.F02: Long history of presumed multiple sclerosis does not strongly support Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder
rationales.F03: Optic neuritis is a common feature of Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder
rationales.F04: Longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis is a hallmark of Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder
rationales.F05: Negative CSF oligoclonal bands are more typical of Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder than multiple sclerosis
rationales.F10: Tumefactive lesion can be seen in both Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder and tumefactive multiple sclerosis
rationales.F11: Aquaporin-4 antibody positivity is highly specific for Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder

frontier_selector.rationale: The presence of a high serum aquaporin-4 antibody titre and a history of longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis, along with optic neuritis episodes, strongly supports Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder, despite the patient's initial presumed diagnosis of multiple sclerosis.
